# Every documented Z80 instruction in Zilog syntax, as GNU as reads it by
# default: `$12`, `12H` and `0x12` numbers, `(IX+d)` operands, `EX AF,AF'`.
# rsasm assembles it in the 8-bit dialect (key `z80`) and in the GNU one
# (key `z80-gas`). A relative jump targets a label on its own line, since
# the GNU dialect has no `$` for the location counter.
